title: चत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Krishna, smiling, tells Karna that since he will not accept the kingdom, the destruction of the earth is certain. He describes how Karna will feel when he sees Arjuna in battle, and asks him to tell Bhishma, Drona and Kripa that the war will begin in seven days, at the new moon.
summary.kn: ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸದಿದ್ದರೆ ಭೂಮಿಯ ನಾಶ ಖಚಿತ ಎಂದು ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ನಗುತ್ತಾ ಕರ್ಣನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಅರ್ಜುನನನ್ನು ಕಂಡಾಗ ಕರ್ಣನಿಗೆ ಏನನಿಸುವುದೆಂದು ವರ್ಣಿಸಿ, ಏಳು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮಾವಾಸ್ಯೆಯಂದು ಯುದ್ಧ ಆರಂಭವೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ, ದ್ರೋಣ, ಕೃಪರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸೆಂದು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: श्रीकृष्ण मुस्कुराते हुए कर्ण से कहते हैं कि चूँकि वह राज्य स्वीकार नहीं करेगा, पृथ्वी का विनाश निश्चित है। वे बताते हैं कि युद्ध में अर्जुन को देखकर कर्ण को कैसा लगेगा, और उससे कहते हैं कि भीष्म, द्रोण और कृप को बताए कि सात दिन में अमावस्या को युद्ध आरम्भ होगा।
summary.te: రాజ్యాన్ని స్వీకరించకపోతే భూమి నాశనం తథ్యమని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు నవ్వుతూ కర్ణునికి చెబుతాడు. యుద్ధంలో అర్జునుని చూసినప్పుడు కర్ణునికి ఎలా అనిపిస్తుందో వర్ణించి, ఏడు రోజుల్లో అమావాస్య నాడు యుద్ధం మొదలవుతుందని భీష్మ ద్రోణ కృపులకు చెప్పమంటాడు.
summary.ta: அரசை ஏற்க மறுத்தால் பூமியின் அழிவு உறுதி என்று ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் புன்னகைத்தபடி கர்ணனிடம் சொல்கிறார். போரில் அர்ஜுனனைக் காணும்போது கர்ணனுக்கு எப்படி இருக்கும் என்று விவரித்து, ஏழு நாட்களில் அமாவாசையன்று போர் தொடங்கும் என்று பீஷ்மர், த்ரோணர், க்ருபரிடம் சொல்லுமாறு கேட்கிறார்.
summary.ml: രാജ്യം സ്വീകരിക്കില്ലെന്നതിനാൽ ഭൂമിയുടെ നാശം ഉറപ്പാണെന്ന് പുഞ്ചിരിയോടെ കൃഷ്ണൻ കർണ്ണനോട് പറയുന്നു. അർജുനനെ യുദ്ധത്തിൽ കാണുമ്പോൾ കർണ്ണന് എന്തനുഭവപ്പെടുമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം വിവരിക്കുന്നു; ഏഴു ദിവസത്തിനകം, അമാവാസിയിൽ യുദ്ധം തുടങ്ങുമെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മരോടും ദ്രോണരോടും കൃപരോടും പറയാൻ അദ്ദേഹം ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.140; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

sections.title: कर्णोपनिवादपर्व
sections.titleEn: Karnopanivada Parva (The secret talks with Karna)

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
कर्णस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा केशवः परवीरहा ।
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं स्मितपूर्वमिदं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Karna's words, Keshava, slayer of enemy heroes, smiled first and then spoke these words, laughing.

verses.text:
अपि त्वां न तपेत्कर्ण राज्यलाभोपपादना ।
मया दत्तां हि पृथिवीं न प्रशासितुमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: "Karna, does the prospect of winning a kingdom not tempt you? You do not wish to rule the earth that I would give you.

verses.text:
ध्रुवो जयः पाण्डवानामितीदं
न संशयः कश्चन विद्यतेऽत्र ।
जयध्वजो दृश्यते पाण्डवस्य
समुच्छ्रितो वानरराज उग्रः ॥

meaning.en: It is certain that the Pandavas will win; there is no doubt about it. The victory banner of the Pandava is seen, the fierce monkey-king raised on high.

verses.text:
दिव्या माया विहिता भौवनेन
समुच्छ्रिता इन्द्रकेतुप्रकाशा ।
दिव्यानि भूतानि भयावहानि
दृश्यन्ति चैवात्र भयानकानि ॥

meaning.en: A divine illusion made by the maker of the worlds stands raised, shining like Indra's banner; divine and fearful beings are seen there, terrifying.

verses.text:
न सज्जते शैलवनस्पतिभ्य
ऊर्ध्वं तिर्यग्योजनमात्ररूपः ।
श्रीमान्ध्वजः कर्ण धनंजयस्य
समुच्छ्रितः पावकतुल्यरूपः ॥

meaning.en: That glorious banner of Dhananjaya, Karna, raised up and blazing like fire, extends a yojana upward and across, and it is never caught on mountains or trees.

verses.text:
यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे श्वेताश्वं कृष्णसारथिम् ।
ऐन्द्रमस्त्रं विकुर्वाणमुभे चैवाग्निमारुते ॥

meaning.en: When you see in battle the white-horsed one with Krishna as his charioteer, working the weapon of Indra, and also those of fire and wind,

verses.text:
गाण्डीवस्य च निर्घोषं विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः ।
न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च ॥

meaning.en: and when you hear the roar of Gandiva like a thunderbolt's crack, then there will be neither Treta nor Krita nor Dvapara.

verses.text:
यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
जपहोमसमायुक्तं स्वां रक्षन्तं महाचमूम् ॥

meaning.en: When you see in battle Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, devoted to prayers and offerings, guarding his own great army,

verses.text:
आदित्यमिव दुर्धर्षं तपन्तं शत्रुवाहिनीम् ।
न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च ॥

meaning.en: blazing like the unassailable sun, scorching the enemy host, then there will be neither Treta nor Krita nor Dvapara.

verses.text:
यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे भीमसेनं महाबलम् ।
दुःशासनस्य रुधिरं पीत्वा नृत्यन्तमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: When you see in battle mighty Bhimasena dancing in the fight after drinking Duhshasana's blood,

verses.text:
प्रभिन्नमिव मातङ्गं प्रतिद्विरदघातिनम् ।
न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च ॥

meaning.en: like a rutting elephant killing opposing elephants, then there will be neither Treta nor Krita nor Dvapara.

verses.text:
यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे माद्रीपुत्रौ महारथौ ।
वाहिनीं धार्तराष्ट्राणां क्षोभयन्तौ गजाविव ॥

meaning.en: When you see in battle the two sons of Madri, great chariot-warriors, shaking the Dhartarashtra army like two elephants,

verses.text:
विगाढे शस्त्रसंपाते परवीररथारुजौ ।
न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च ॥

meaning.en: breaking the chariots of enemy heroes when the fall of weapons is thick, then there will be neither Treta nor Krita nor Dvapara.

verses.text:
यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे द्रोणं शांतनवं कृपम् ।
सुयोधनं च राजानं सैन्धवं च जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: When you see in battle Drona, Shantanu's son Bhishma, Kripa, King Suyodhana and Jayadratha of Sindhu,

verses.text:
युद्धायापततस्तूर्णं वारितान्सव्यसाचिना ।
न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च ॥

meaning.en: rushing swiftly to fight and held back by Savyasachin, then there will be neither Treta nor Krita nor Dvapara.

verses.text:
ब्रूयाः कर्ण इतो गत्वा द्रोणं शांतनवं कृपम् ।
सौम्योऽयं वर्तते मासः सुप्रापयवसेन्धनः ॥

meaning.en: Karna, go from here and say to Drona, Bhishma and Kripa: this month is mild, with plenty of fodder and fuel.

verses.text:
पक्वौषधिवनस्फीतः फलवानल्पमक्षिकः ।
निष्पङ्को रसवत्तोयो नात्युष्णशिशिरः सुखः ॥

meaning.en: The woods are rich with ripe herbs, the trees fruitful, flies few, no mud, the water tasty, the weather neither too hot nor cold, and pleasant.

verses.text:
सप्तमाच्चापि दिवसादमावास्या भविष्यति ।
संग्रामं योजयेत्तत्र तां ह्याहुः शक्रदेवताम् ॥

meaning.en: Seven days from now there will be the new moon; let the battle be joined then, for they say it belongs to the deity Shakra.

verses.text:
तथा राज्ञो वदेः सर्वान्ये युद्धायाभ्युपागताः ।
यद्वो मनीषितं तद्वै सर्वं संपादयामि वः ॥

meaning.en: And tell all the kings who have come for the war: 'I will bring about for you all that you have in mind.'

verses.text:
राजानो राजपुत्राश्च दुर्योधनवशानुगाः ।
प्राप्य शस्त्रेण निधनं प्राप्स्यन्ति गतिमुत्तमाम् ॥

meaning.en: The kings and princes who follow Duryodhana's will, meeting death by the weapon, will attain the highest goal."
